children: Yields on U.K. government bonds, or gilts, climb due to inflation worries as oil prices rise further. U.S.-Iran hostilities intensified, with the U.S. striking Iranian oil tankers on Tuesday in retaliation to Iran's attacks on U.S. warships. As a result, Brent crude price rises 2.1% to $99.99 per barrel. Ten-year gilt yields rise 2.3 basis points to last trade at 5.185%, Tradeweb data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
